The '''2018–19 Vanderbilt Commodores men's basketball team''' represented [[Vanderbilt University]] in the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were coached by [[Bryce Drew]] in his third season at Vanderbilt. The Commodores played their home games at [[Memorial Gymnasium (Vanderbilt University)|Memorial Gymnasium]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]] as members of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. They finished the season 9–23, 0–18 to finish in last place in [[2018–19 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]]. They were the first SEC team to go winless in a season since the 1954 Georgia Tech team, and the first team ever in the 18-game conference schedule.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26213289/lsu-fans-deride-ad-sec-title-clinching-rout|title=LSU fans deride AD during SEC title-clinching rout|last=|first=|date=|website=|publisher=ESPN.com|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190310124911/http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26213289/lsu-fans-deride-ad-sec-title-clinching-rout |archive-date=2019-03-10 |accessdate=10 March 2019}}</ref> They lost in the first round of the [[2019 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2018–19 Texas A&M Aggies men's basketball team|Texas A&M]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2019/03/13/sec-basketball-tournament-2019-vanderbilt-texas-a-m-billy-kennedy-bryce-drew/3125127002/|title=Vanderbilt's worst basketball season ever ends with SEC Tournament loss to Texas A&M|last=|first=|date=|website=|publisher=The Tennessean|accessdate=13 March 2019}}</ref>

On March 22, 2019, the school fired Drew as head coach after three years in Nashville.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tennessean.com/story/sports/college/vanderbilt/2019/03/22/vanderbilt-basketball-bryce-drew-fired/3196259002/|title=Vanderbilt basketball coach Bryce Drew reacts to firing in his first tweet|website=The Tennessean|language=en|access-date=2019-04-29}}</ref> On April 5, the school hired former NBA player and NBA assistant coach [[Jerry Stackhouse]] as head coach.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/26424522|title=Vanderbilt, off winless SEC run, hires Stackhouse|date=2019-04-02|website=ESPN.com|language=en|access-date=2019-04-29}}</ref>

==Previous season==
They finished the season 12–20, 6–12 in SEC play to finish in 13th place. They lost in the first round of the [[2018 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] to [[2017–18 Georgia Bulldogs basketball team|Georgia]].
